tools.name: zensei_index_about
tools.description: What the Zensei Index is, how to read the score, how it is built, and what this server serves (free and Premium). Same wording as the website FAQ. Call it once before interpreting any score.

tools.name: zensei_index_today
tools.description: Today's Zensei Index for U.S. equities: the final score, its regime label, and the three layer scores (structural conditions, tactical filters, regime confirmations). The Zensei Index is a RISK score from 0 to 100: LOWER IS HEALTHIER. 0-20 Supportive, 20-40 Vulnerable, 40-70 Stressed, 70-100 Restric

tools.name: zensei_index_indicators
tools.description: The ten indicators behind today's Zensei Index, each with its current status, the layer it scores into, its weight in that layer, and the same explanation the website shows. Use it to explain why the index sits where it does. Indicator statuses run from healthiest to most stressed: Clear or Inactive

tools.name: zensei_index_summary
tools.description: The latest written summary of the Zensei Index, with the score and regime it was written for. A summary is rewritten only when the indicators change. Check `stale` and `ageDays` before quoting it as today's view, and prefer zensei_index_today for the current number. The Zensei Index is a RISK score

tools.name: zensei_index_history
tools.description: Daily Zensei Index scores for the last `days` calendar days, with the regime of each day. Free access covers the last 31 days; Premium covers up to 3650 days. The Zensei Index is a RISK score from 0 to 100: LOWER IS HEALTHIER. 0-20 Supportive, 20-40 Vulnerable, 40-70 Stressed, 70-100 Restrictive. A

tools.name: zensei_sectors_scan
tools.description: How each sector ETF performs against the S&P 500 (SPY), placed in four quadrants by its 3-month (X) and 1-month (Y) change vs SPY: Outperformers (ahead on both), Emerging (behind over 3 months, ahead over 1 month), Cooling (ahead over 3 months, behind over 1 month) and Underperformers (behind on bot

tools.name: zensei_sector_detail
tools.description: One sector ETF in depth: its quadrant, momentum and returns vs SPY, valuation, and its largest holdings (up to 25). For each holding: weight, quadrant against the sector ETF (not against SPY), momentum, 1-month change and the gap to the sector. The 11 broad S&P 500 sectors (XLK, XLF, XLV, XLE, XLI,

tools.name: zensei_stock_detail
tools.description: How one stock performs against a sector ETF that holds it (its 'lens'): returns over 1w to 1y and the gap to the sector, relative-strength trend, valuation, next earnings date, and every tracked sector that holds it with its quadrant there. Without `sector`, the free tier uses a broad S&P 500 sector

tools.name: zensei_search
tools.description: Find sector ETFs and stocks tracked by Zensei by ticker or name. Returns each stock with the sector ETFs that hold it, largest weight first. Needs Zensei Premium.

tools.name: zensei_my_watchlist
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved symbols on Zensei, with the sector each one is pinned to. Reads the "Favorites" list unless `list` names another. Needs a Zensei account; custom lists are a Premium feature. Pass each symbol to zensei_stock_detail or zensei_sector_detail for figures.

tools.name: zensei_view_sector
tools.description: Used by the Zensei sector map view to open one sector's holdings inside the view. Not for direct use: call zensei_sector_detail instead.

tools.name: zensei_view_indicators
tools.description: Used by the Zensei Index view to draw the ten indicator charts inside the view. Not for direct use: call zensei_index_indicators instead.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "zensei_index_about" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What the Zensei Index is, how to read the score, how it is built, and what this server serves. Same wording as the website FAQ. Call it once before interpreting any score." → after: "What the Zensei Index is, how to read the score, how it is built, and what this server serves (free and Premium). Same wording as the website FAQ. Call it once before interpreting any score."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
